name: 古林河畔
art: A broad grassy meadow in the ancient forest, a small narrow stream ONLY around outer edges and wooden bridge ornaments there, clear earthy crossroads and central grass clearing, distant wooded rocks at the perimeter.
prompt: Original hand-painted pre-rendered-looking 2D isometric dark fantasy RPG game asset. Cohesive weathered stone, iron, wood and natural materials, readable midtones and clear paths, atmospheric deep shadows only around architecture, restrained warm torchlight and cool ambient fill. Crisp details at gameplay scale, no blur, no photo, no modern 3D perspective. No commercial game copies, logos, text, characters, monsters, HUD, frames or watermark. Landscape 4:3 orthographic ground tile. A broad grassy meadow in the ancient forest, a small narrow stream ONLY around outer edges and wooden bridge ornaments there, clear earthy crossroads and central grass clearing, distant wooded rocks at the perimeter. STRICT WALKABILITY COMPOSITION: the middle 52% width by 46% height is completely clear traversable ground. A wide straight unobstructed road extends from the center to the EXACT CENTER of EACH of all FOUR edges (north, east, south, west). No object, cliff, water, stairs or wall may cross these four paths. At all four edge midpoints the road surface fills at least 18% of that edge. Paths blend smoothly to edge with no dark frame. Trees, tall ruins, water, pits and buildings stay in outer corner quadrants. Near overhead 3/4 orthographic camera, no sky or horizon. Asset is to connect with neighboring terrain tiles, all roads at precise edge centers.
